keys.name: RIGHT_TOUCHDOWN_SPIKE

keys.name: RENDEZVOUS_COIL

keys.name: RENDEZVOUS_CONTACT

keys.motion_arc_root_note: root and torso remain committed forward at contact; no instant settle
keys.causal_role: single scoped clock join: hand and token meet at maximum information density

keys.name: ABSORB_CONTACT

keys.motion_arc_root_note: root continues past contact then sinks; elbow folds as the captured token drags the shoulder chain

keys.name: TORSO_OVERSHOOT

keys.name: RECOVERY_DEBT
